files.description: The registered URL page — a mandatory ONC disclosure page containing certified EHR product information, certification criteria listing, and cost transparency details. The entire (b)(10) EHI export documentation is a single footnote on this page: 'EHI can be exported in PDF or C-CDA format. Records for a patient are exported to one or more PDF/C-CDA files. The files created by the export are saved to a folder specified by the user.'

Full-page screenshot of the disclosure and transparency page captured via Chrome DevTools. Shows the complete page layout including the certification criteria table with the (b)(10) footnote, cost transparency section, and API documentation links.

FHIR R4 service base URL directory for UMC customers, linked from the disclosure page. Contains a nearly-empty FHIR Bundle with no endpoint entries, indicating no active UMC customer FHIR API integrations. This is the (g)(10) API endpoint directory, not related to the (b)(10) EHI export.

EMR Direct Interoperability Engine Open API Documentation page, linked from the disclosure page under 'Application Access API Additional Information.' This is the FHIR R4 API documentation for (g)(10) compliance — covers authentication, OAuth 2.0, SMART App Launch, US Core resources, and Bulk Data Access. Not specific to UMC or to the (b)(10) EHI export, but included because the disclosure page references it as supplementary API documentation.
